checkpoint_review: The Router was appropriately strict. It correctly identified that while the image mimics the *visual texture* of a menu, it fails the functional and structural definitions required by the taxonomy. Specifically, the 'structured typography' and 'systematic listing' checkpoints were correctly marked false due to the pervasive gibberish. The Router did not skip any testable checkpoints; all were evaluated with sound reasoning based on the visual evidence of text corruption.
artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings for 'text_gibberish' (4.2) and 'structural_collapse' (3.7) are accurate and supported by the Image Text Auditor's low confidence scores (mostly <0.65) and nonsensical output (e.g., 'muc', 'tsruted'). The 'fusion' artifact (3.1) is also well-supported by the Topology Boundary Auditor's mask, which shows a coherent but likely merged region between the illustration and text. The Router may have slightly underestimated the 'perspective_distortion' (2.3); the Geometric Depth Auditor's high standard deviation (3.6) suggests significant planar irregularity, which, combined with the warped text on the right edge, points to a more severe geometric failure (likely ~3.0). However, the text artifacts are the dominant issue.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier failed to identify the image as a 'menu' (Top-1: 'envelope'), indicating a fundamental semantic mismatch. Only 2/9 checkpoints passed (decorative element, paper stock), and even those are compromised by surrounding artifacts. The image lacks the defining functional characteristic of a menu: legible, organized information. It is visually similar to a menu but functionally an abstract pattern of pseudo-text.
artifact_reasoning: Severe text generation failure dominates the image. The Image Text Auditor confirms widespread gibberish with low OCR confidence, validating the Router's 'text_gibberish' observation. Structural collapse in the lower quadrants and fusion between the header illustration and body text further degrade quality. While the paper texture is plausible, the geometric warping and textual incoherence constitute catastrophic artifacts for this class.
key_defects: Structural collapse of typographic grid (lines merging/vanishing)
Fusion of decorative illustration into adjacent text
Geometric warping of planar surface (right-edge distortion)
